title: Area and perimeter of an L-shape
subject: math

items.prompt: An L-shape is made of part A, 200 by 120, and part B, 120 by 140. It fits inside a box that is 200 by 260. What is the area of the L-shape?
items.misconceptionCode: The area of the L-shape is the length times the width of its bounding box.

items.prompt: What is the area of part A of the L, a rectangle 200 by 120?
Part B of the L is 120 by 140. Find its area and then the total area of the L, given part A has area 24 000.
What is the area of a rectangle 120 by 140?
Which pair of edges are the inner steps of the L that are easy to miss when finding the perimeter?
Explain in one sentence why the area of the L is not 200 x 260.
items.answer: The 200 by 260 box includes an empty corner that is not part of the L, so only the filled parts count.
